notes: The English *It* of the second colon realizes the finite verb's own person and number under rule 17.
The generic *one* expanding `כֹּל` joins the quantifier's unit under rule 31 and does not move the chain's *of*, which rule 19 places on `כֹּל` as rectum of `אָרְחוֹת`.
Two supplied *the*s in `נֶפֶשׁ בְּעָלָיו`: no article morpheme stands in the phrase, so each noun takes the one standing before its own word under rule 29's counting sentences.
